intro: Blocked checks, refused attempts and scheduled alerts that concern you. Each agent marks their own alerts as read.

messages.CREDIT_INSUFFISANT: Commitment refused: {{depassement}} XOF above the available credit.
messages.DEPASSEMENT_MARCHE: Commitment refused: {{depassement}} XOF above the contract amount left to commit.
messages.AVENANT_NECESSAIRE: The need exceeds the contract cap by {{depassement}} XOF: an amendment or a derogation is needed.
messages.FACTURE_SUP_RECEPTION: Settlement above received, invoice or amount due ({{depassement}} XOF).
messages.SERVICE_FAIT_MANQUANT: Settlement refused: no approved receipt proves the service delivery.
messages.PAIEMENT_SUP_LIQUIDE: Payment refused on settlement {{numero}}: share of {{part}} XOF for {{resteDu}} XOF due.
messages.FACTURE_ECHUE: Invoice {{numero}}, received on {{recueLe}}, not paid in time.
messages.ECART_RAPPROCHEMENT: Reconciliation of invoice {{numero}} recorded with a gap: {{explication}}
messages.ENGAGEMENT_ANCIEN: Commitment {{numero}}, approved on {{valideLe}}, still not completed.
messages.MODIFICATION_APRES_VALIDATION: Change refused on an operation with status {{statut}}.
messages.ECART_RAPPROCHEMENT_HOPITALIA_MODIFIE: Receipt {{numero}}: the delivery was changed in Hopitalia after receipt. Check the receipt and the invoice.
messages.ECART_RAPPROCHEMENT_HOPITALIA_SUPPRIME: Receipt {{numero}} cancelled: the delivery was deleted in Hopitalia. Check the order's settlements.
